summary: Work item #45's triage stalled three times (no hand-back before the stall timeout). Triage requires no capabilities (no `requires` in .factory/policy.json, none from the agent), so placement wasn't it; the runner was. In the incident #11 window (2026-11-12, load 17-25) runner-local's capacity() read a tmux session listing that timed out as zero sessions, so the host reported nothing in use, kept claiming triage jobs into the overloaded machine, and they never handed back in time. Fixed in code by spec 43 (ADR 0550, 0552) with tests only; this check keeps the pattern out of every runner adapter.

cases.content: for (const s of await tmux.jobSessions().catch(() => [])) await tmux.kill(s.name);
